{
  "name": "cache-timer",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Live countdown above the prompt until your session's prompt cache expires, with an optional keep-alive that keeps it warm while you're away",
  "author": {
    "name": "Marek Bartczak"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/MarekBartczak/claude-cache-timer",
  "repository": "https://github.com/MarekBartczak/claude-cache-timer",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "prompt-cache",
    "cache",
    "keep-alive",
    "tokens",
    "status"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "ttl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt cache TTL",
      "description": "Assumed TTL until the mod learns the real one (model switch or an observed cache hit/miss)",
      "default": "1h",
      "options": [
        "1h",
        "5m"
      ]
    },
    "keepAlive": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cache keep-alive",
      "description": "How long after your last prompt to keep refreshing the cache before it expires (each refresh is one cache read of the session)",
      "default": "4h",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "1h",
        "2h",
        "4h",
        "8h"
      ]
    }
  }
}
